title: The NeuroProtect Formula: A Preventive Approach to AD Targeting the HIF-1/PI3K-AKT Signaling Pathway Evaluated through In Vivo, In Vitro, and Network Pharmacology Approaches.
authors: Li, Haiyan; Hua, Qian; Cheng, Shuo; Liu, Xiaoge; Cai, Qingyuan; Zhang, Jiani; Peng, Tiantian; Li, Jiao; Wang, Chunxiang; Liang, Chengbang; Shi, Yu; Wang, Xu; Tan, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对阿尔茨海默病的预防作用，虽含分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with limited options for reversing its middle-to-late stages. Early intervention is crucial to slow down disease progression. This study aimed to investigate the potential of the NeuroProtect (NP) formula, a combination of geniposide and Panax notoginseng saponins, in preventing AD. We evaluated the effects of the NP formula on amyloid plaque accumulation, neuronal degeneration, and molecular signaling pathways using In Vivo and In Vitro models. METHODS: To predict functional pathways and potential downstream targets of NP intervention, we employed network pharmacology. The preventative impact of the NP formula was assessed using APP/PS1 mice. We conducted HE staining, ELISA assay, Golgi staining, and immunohistochemistry to detect the protective effect of NP. Additionally, cell experiments were performed to assess cell activity and target protein expression. RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis revealed 145 drug-disease interactions and identified 5 core active targets associated with AD. Molecular docking results demonstrated strong binding affinity between the components of the NP formula (GP, GN-Rb1, GN-Rg1, NS-R1) and target proteins (STAT3, HIF1A, TLR4, mTOR, VEGFA). Notably, the binding energy between NS-R1 and mTOR was -11.4kcal/mol. Among the top 10 enriched KEGG pathways, the HIF-1 and PI3K-AKT signaling pathways were highlighted. In Vivo experiments demonstrated that the NP formula significantly ameliorated pathological changes, decreased the Abeta(42)/Abeta(40) ratio in the hippocampus and cortex, and increased dendritic spine density in the CA1 region during the early stage of AD. In Vitro experiments further illustrated the NP formula's ability to reverse the inhibitory effects of Abeta(25-35) on cell viability and regulate the expression of Tlr4, Mtor, Hif1a, Stat3, and Vegfa. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that NP exhibits neuroprotective effects during the early stages of AD, positioning it as a potential candidate for AD prevention. The NP formula may exert its preventive effects through the HIF-1/PI3K-AKT signaling pathway, with mTOR identified as a key target.
abstract_zh: 目的：阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's Disease, AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，其中晚期阶段的可逆治疗选择有限。早期干预对于减缓疾病进展至关重要。本研究旨在探讨NeuroProtect（NP）配方（栀子苷和三七总皂苷的组合）在预防AD方面的潜力。我们使用体内和体外模型评估了NP配方对淀粉样斑块积累、神经元变性和分子信号通路的影响。方法：采用网络药理学预测NP干预的功能通路和潜在下游靶点。使用APP/PS1小鼠评估NP配方的预防效果。我们进行了HE染色、ELISA检测、高尔基染色和免疫组化以检测NP的保护作用。此外，进行了细胞实验以评估细胞活性和靶蛋白表达。结果：网络药理学分析揭示了145个药物-疾病相互作用，并确定了与AD相关的5个核心活性靶点。分子对接结果显示，NP配方成分（GP、GN-Rb1、GN-Rg1、NS-R1）与靶蛋白（STAT3、HIF1A、TLR4、mTOR、VEGFA）之间具有强结合亲和力。值得注意的是，NS-R1与mTOR之间的结合能为-11.4 kcal/mol。在富集的前10条KEGG通路中，HIF-1和PI3K-AKT信号通路被突出显示。体内实验表明，在AD早期阶段，NP配方显著改善了病理变化，降低了海马和皮层中的Abeta(42)/Abeta(40)比值，并增加了CA1区域的树突棘密度。体外实验进一步表明，NP配方能够逆转Abeta(25-35)对细胞活力的抑制作用，并调节Tlr4、Mtor、Hif1a、Stat3和Vegfa的表达。结论：我们的研究结果表明，NP在AD早期阶段表现出神经保护作用，使其成为AD预防的潜在候选药物。NP配方可能通过HIF-1/PI3K-AKT信号通路发挥其预防作用，其中mTOR被确定为关键靶点。
